name: NextDNS
whyPeoplePay: NextDNS sells DNS that is already everywhere: blocklists, analytics and per-device profiles without running a resolver at home. You pay so phones on cellular and laptops in cafes keep the same policy without a VPN back to your house.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Unlimited queries on the advertised Pro tier; confirm current price on the vendor page.

pricing.note: Confirm the Pro figure on nextdns.io/pricing before quoting savings; DNS products change promotions often. Recorded as a low flat monthly for a single household config.

ranked.rationale: Network-wide DNS blocking you run yourself. Best on a home LAN where you control the router; a public VPS as recursive DNS is a different and riskier shape.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Pi-hole
evaluatedNotTested.note: The classic ad-blocking DNS. Surveyed, not installed here; AdGuard Home was ranked for a single-container image and a modern UI.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Blocky
evaluatedNotTested.note: Lightweight DNS proxy with blocklists. Surveyed only.
